selection.signal: At least one precise N-terminal Signal feature starting at 1, ending between 20 and 40 inclusive, with ECO:0000269 experimental positional evidence
selection.sequence: 20 standard amino acids, canonical exact sequence
selection.independence: One representative per MMseqs2 connected-component cluster at 30% identity and 80% coverage; retain cluster membership and command/version

primary_statistic: Per-protein mean positive Extracellular SHAP per residue in complete 10-residue regions wholly within the precise signal, minus mean positive SHAP per residue in nonoverlapping 10-residue nonsignal regions in the same first-50-residue terminal stratum. Equal weight per independent group.
coverage: Report all included and excluded proteins and reasons; signals without both eligible positive and matched control regions are excluded before statistics.
negative_control: Randomize signal-annotation to attribution-profile pairing among proteins in the same 50-residue sequence-length bin and N-terminal start stratum. Retain exact signal endpoints, complete region grids and terminal bias. Singleton strata cannot contribute to the matched permutation test.
sensitivity_subset: First three eligible accession-ordered proteins; repeat coalition seed and double budget using the same reference game
claims: Model-behavior concordance only. Audit known localization/sorting-signal supervision overlap; unknown foundation pretraining overlap precludes independent generalization claims. Publish null results without tuning the protocol. Synthetic controls validate software only.
